LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_ArriveLabel: A buyer drawn by your name
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_ArriveText: A travel-worn ratkin buyer, {PAWN_labelShort}, has walked into your settlement, saying they heard your name all along the road and came specially to buy arms from you, the blacksmith. Go greet your guest.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_Title: A Buyer Drawn by Your Name
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_Report: Discuss the arms deal with the wandering buyer
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_Greeting: You're the one? Word on the road is there's a fine blacksmith in these parts. I'm buying weapons — four of them. I'm not picky about the style, just so they work; only one rule: the quality's got to be decent, don't fob me off with scrap iron. I can pay — enough to match four proper steel swords, all told. Deal!
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_OptDeliver: Deliver: open the picker window and choose the weapons by hand
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_OptDeliverTrade: Deliver: open the trade window and sell them the weapons
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_NeedGoods: You can't muster goods that qualify (four weapons, Normal+ quality, total value matching four normal steel longswords)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_MsgPaid: The buyer hefts each weapon you hand over, more pleased by the moment, and counts out silver without a quibble: "Fine work! Worth the trip. I'll be back — and I'll spread your name around, too."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_OptTerms: Ask what they want the weapons for
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_Terms1: (They're vague about it.) "Self-defense, guarding a place, working the trade roads... plenty of uses for a good weapon. You just forge them well, I'll just pay well, and let's neither of us ask more than that."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_Thanks: The buyer wraps the weapons carefully and stows them, then salutes you with a fist-to-palm: "A pleasure! Till we meet again, blacksmith." And with that, they're back on the road.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_OptDecline: Nothing on hand — pass on this one
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_BandMsg1: The buyer counts over the weapons you delivered, satisfied with the deal, and pays the silver in full.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_Buyer_BandMsg2: The buyer never expected you could produce goods this fine — delighted, they add extra to the payment, swearing they'll spread your name up and down the whole trade road!
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_DeliverWindow_Req: Requires {0}~{1} weapons, quality {2} or better; the higher the total value delivered, the better the pay and reputation (baseline target about {3} silver).
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_DeliverWindow_Band: Selected {0} weapons, total value {1} silver — tier {2} delivery.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Forge_DeliverWindow_Short: Selected {0} weapons, total value {1} silver (below the delivery threshold).
